title: Gildspire – My First Playable Fantasy RPG, Built with AI Assisted game Development
author: Vigneshk1706
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I’ve spent the past few weeks bringing a fantasy world I’ve imagined to life, and I’ve finally reached the point where I have a playable demo to share!

Gildspire is a fantasy action RPG set in a world of ancient gods, forgotten secrets, and mysteries waiting to be uncovered.

I’ve been using AI development tools alongside Unreal Engine to help turn my ideas into something playable, from building environments and implementing gameplay mechanics to working through technical challenges. It’s been quite an experience seeing how much is possible with these tools, especially as someone learning game development along the way.

There’s still plenty to improve, but I’m excited to keep building on it.

I’d love to hear from others who’ve used AI for game development. What have you found works well, and where have you struggled?

And if you’d like to try Gildspire, I’d genuinely appreciate any feedback on the gameplay, exploration, or atmosphere.

Play the demo: [https://veilfire.itch.io/gildspire-valorias-fall](https://veilfire.itch.io/gildspire-valorias-fall)

Thanks so much for taking a look!
